Root cause fixed: old version hardcoded the 2026-07-15 story (84-88%/283, 'shortest lags') and would have flagged the corrected paper as wrong. Not yet run.

Queue toward Aug 29 AoE deadline (Eval of Interactive Agents @ NeurIPS 2026): (1) USER: D13 one-commit fix (.gitignore scope + commit docs/analysis/sources/CSVs/paper) then rerun bench.py report for true manifest hash; (2) D10 group-definition rewording + D11 classify_seeds.py + softened curation sentence; (3) D12 pre-registered duration-confound test (local compute); (4) prose dedup/trim pass (~500 words + layout levers toward 9pp); (5) run rewritten paper-check gate; PAID awaiting greenlight: D6 re-grade with non-OpenAI grader (~$3-5), repeats ablation (~$150-250), open-weights/SLM row (~$50); user decisions: arXiv v2, gemini stray row cleanup.

D12 MEASURED via pre-registered F6/F7 (analysis/kdr_duration.py): F6 per-seed KDR rises with longest port blockage, Spearman +0.443 sonnet [+0.163,+0.681] Holm .0054 / +0.358 grok .015 / +0.618 deepseek <1e-4 / gpt +0.244 n.s. .092; F7 PERSISTENT membership no detectable partial association given duration, Holm >= .086 all four (gpt borderline raw .022). Paper Sec.5 reframed: peak is duration-driven. check.sh green, 19 em / 9,907 words / 20pp; pages 6+9 rasterized and inspected.

Dedup trim pass applied from slop-audit list: intro no longer restates abstract numbers, trace narrative compressed (quote verified verbatim in seed1 trace), discussion oracle-asymmetry now references Sec.4, D1 footnote deduped vs Table 5 caption, AQL jargon replaced with defined term, misc tightenings. 9,907 -> 9,669 words; check.sh green; pages 2/7/10/11 rasterized and inspected clean. BUT main text measures ~11.3pp vs the 9pp limit (references start 32% down p.12) — Table 5 oracle rows + excess/duration paragraphs grew the paper since the ~10pp estimate. Remaining ~2pp requires layout levers (move Algorithm 1 / Table 1 to appendix, shrink figures, compress Sec.3) — user decision pending.

Page-budget pass (user approved all levers): Algorithm 1 -> appendix, related-work Table -> appendix, world diagram (fig_world) -> appendix, fig1/fig2 shrunk (fig2 regenerated at 1.95in height, cross-validation asserts pass), Tables belief+confound MERGED into one (diag column was duplicate of 'all' KDR), Sec.6 tightened (all disclosures kept), caption/intro trims. Main text 11.3pp -> 9.78pp vs 9pp limit; 9,508 words; check.sh green; merged-table + fig2 pages inspected. Remaining ~0.8pp requires content-touching cuts (trace narrative -> appendix ~0.25pp, Sec.5 residuals ~0.15, uncertainty prose ~0.1, Sec.2 deeper trim ~0.15, abstract ~0.05) — menu sent to user.

Venue compliance verified by live fetch (not memory): Eval of Interactive Agents @ NeurIPS 2026 (eval-interactive-agents-workshop.github.io) confirmed as-is -- deadline Aug 29 2026 AoE, notification Sep 29 2026 AoE, full 9pp/short 4pp excl. refs+appendix, NeurIPS 2026 style (neurips_2026.sty last revision Jan 2026, confirmed genuine), double-blind required ('remove author names and affiliations, and avoid identifying information in the text, acknowledgments, and links'), non-archival, dual-submission explicitly permitted, OpenReview venue live at openreview.net/group?id=NeurIPS.cc/2026/Workshop/IAEval. No workshop-specific LLM-disclosure clause found on their CFP; NeurIPS 2026 MainTrackHandbook LLM policy (agents/LLM use in method must be described if important/original/non-standard; spellcheck/basic editing exempt) is scoped to main track only, no parallel workshop clause found -- so workshop LLM policy is UNKNOWN/inherits none explicitly.

Paper.tex double-blind readiness check: grep for QpiAI/author names/emails/github.com/acknowledgments/thank found matches ONLY in the \author{} block (Sagar Deb, Ashwanth Krishnan, QpiAI, both emails) -- no acknowledgments section, no self-identifying links, no 'our prior work' leakage found elsewhere in the file. Style currently loaded as \usepackage[preprint]{neurips_2026} (line 6) which shows author names -- file's own comment (line 3-4) documents the fix: drop to no-option for anonymous submission. This is a known, cheap, not-yet-done step, not a content problem. Current build: paper.pdf 20 pages total; per prior page-budget pass (PROJECT-LOG page-budget entry) main text is ~9.78pp vs 9pp limit, ~0.8pp still over, cut menu already sent to user, decision pending.

Five web-grounded adversarial audits complete (venue/novelty/method/stats/construct, all citations fetched not recalled). Venue: Aug 29 AoE + 9pp excl refs + DOUBLE-BLIND confirmed (must drop [preprint]); backup venue Who Verifies the Agents (same deadline). Novelty: SAFE — nothing combines fair oracle + stress axis + belief grading; must-cite MerchantBench 2607.28956 + Belief at Risk 2606.15473. Method: 'Bayes-optimal' overclaims (certainty-equivalent rollout; Bozkurt 2602.02814, Hansson 2605.22965); oracle menu lacks briefing/audit levers the agent has; base-stock floor ignores lead-time variance (inflates C_base worst on PERSISTENT/COMPOUND). Stats: pre-registration unverifiable until ledgers committed (sharpest, free); single-run below Blackwell 3-rep bar (disclosed; repeats ablation neutralizes); compute Kotawala resolvability q free; F7 needs conditional-permutation robustness. Construct: 'stated belief = lower bound' not supported as monotone by CoT-faithfulness lit (Turpin 2305.04388, Anthropic 2505.05410) — Table 5 escalation is our defense, must be wired to it; same-family grader bias citable (2508.06709), stratify audit by generator; seed curation filters on headroom (undisclosed spread inflation); prompt-sensitivity threatens the two-tier RANKING (POSIX 2410.02185).

FINAL-PLAN.md written and LOCKED (user directive: stop moving fast, lock the list). Freeze rule: nothing added without dropping equal effort; new ideas go to post-submission. Phases: 0 = user D13 commit TODAY (also the pre-registration evidence); 1 = free wording/citation fixes + local analyses (M1-M5, N1-N3, C1-C6, S2-S6, V3-V4, floor robustness M3, oracle full-menu M2b, land 9.0pp) by ~Aug 12; 2 = paid decisions by Aug 15 (D6 regrade -5 RECOMMENDED, repeats 50-250 RECOMMENDED, C5b paraphrase 5-30 optional); 3 = submission week (bib swap, paper-check gate, anonymize, OpenReview >=24h early). Explicit not-doing list: no metric redefinitions, no reclassification, no new arms/models, no further attack hunts.

Hostile OR/benchmark review (sonnet agent, user-requested; overrides no-more-attack-hunts for this one pass). Reproduction clean: floor costs byte-identical for all 50 seeds vs skill_scores.csv; oracle costs (7 seeds, 5-rep reruns) within 1 SE of oracle_refs.csv 20-rep means. New findings: A2 SERIOUS — on models diagnosed-and-stockout weeks the oracle itself stocks out 69-85% at comparable dollar magnitude (grok ratio 1.001), so much of the knowing-doing gap on those weeks is physics not conversion failure (reviewer-computed, NOT yet canonical — needs backend/analysis recompute before paper use); A3 floor within 0.15% of true best static policy by grid search (defuses arbitrary-zero attack, strengthens M3); A4 learned-oracle refit covers transitions only, not emissions/topology (M5 scope sentence must say so); A6 C3 consequence sentence still missing; A1 = M1 unapplied. All other axes survived (factored independence, cost non-degeneracy, malformed-call handling, single-SKU scoping).

Two web surveys (sonnet agents, all papers fetched not recalled). (1) Seed-taxonomy norms across 12 benchmarks: named difficulty taxonomies are rare; closest comparators (RetailBench, MerchantBench, InventoryBench 2602.12631) use NO composite stress groups — aggregate main-body results, factor/covariate disaggregation separate; GAIA keeps its 3 levels only because outcome-validated post-hoc, a test our groups FAIL (D12: duration drives KDR, not group membership). Verdict: aggregate + continuous blockage-duration covariate is MORE standard than our ISOLATED/PERSISTENT/COMPOUND. NEW must-check citation: InventoryBench 2602.12631 (1,320 instances, factorial axes) — not currently cited. (2) Factored-POMDP novelty: only exact match on the web is our own arXiv v1 2607.13618 (agent found it blind); external near-neighbors (RetailBench privileged oracle, MerchantBench feedback-latency observability, YC-Bench deterministic monolithic hidden state, POPGym no LLM) all fail on factored-latent + exact-filter + fair-reference combo. Claim confirmed defensible.

D15 clean harness built: build_agent(harness='clean') uses plain langchain.agents.create_agent (no middleware, prompt verbatim); smoke test: clean binds exactly the 6 world tools vs deep's 15 (6 world + write_todos, 6 file tools, execute, task). CLI play_agent --harness clean, trace suffix -clean. Default stays 'deep'. Addendum: deepagents SummarizationMiddleware present in default stack (trigger ~85% ctx / 170k fallback) but NEVER fired in the 200 runs - largest trace 42KB (~10k tok); only 'summarize' matches are agents' own todo text.

Harness-design survey (sonnet agent, 8 benchmarks + 3 confound papers fetched+read): modal design = bare messages-API loop, domain tools only, paper-authored prompt verbatim (tau-bench litellm for-loop; Vending-Bench 'basic loop' with explicit bias rationale; AgentBench simple CoT; InventoryBench stateless per-period call). No surveyed benchmark uses LangChain/deepagents as primary harness. MerchantBench = exact D15 analog (ReAct minimal vs Hermes runtime-wrapped, treated as labeled variable). Confound literature: 2605.23950 harness-variance 7.8x model-variance, 6 ranking reversals, 'Harness Card' disclosure; 2606.08529 scaffold swings up to 28pts, 'elicitation gap'; 2605.27922 weaker models MORE harness-sensitive (matches our differential todo uptake); SWE-agent 2405.15793 ACI = interface-as-variable. New citation candidates for the paper.

Supersedes the 06:35 fix event's harness='clean' flag design: user directed full deletion of deepagents instead of an opt-in flag. deepagents removed from codebase and pyproject (langchain added as direct dep in the agent group). build_agent is now single-path plain create_agent; step_gated keeps working via langchain HumanInTheLoopMiddleware (same middleware deepagents wrapped -- verified same decisions/approve/action_requests schema, app.py advance endpoint unchanged). --harness CLI flag and -clean trace suffix removed (suffix would have broken bench.py trace_path skip-if-done). bench.py manifest now records harness: ladder-v1 stamped 'deepagents 0.6.10 scaffold (D15)', later exps 'clean'. Verified: both modes bind exactly the 6 world tools; 160/160 tests pass; py_compile clean; reproducing July runs needs pre-2026-08-06 checkout (git history retains deepagents pin).

Seed audit of current 50 (canonical 20-rep refs + sweep + passive replays): 5 bad seeds - 11 (headroom -218, UNSCOREABLE), 164 (488 THIN), 160 (583 THIN), 36 (584 THIN), 24 (headroom 1205 but stress onset week 24 with 1 stressed week, model spread 0.45 = lowest). Other 45 healthy: headroom 723-2532, onset weeks 1-13, oracle beats best static policy on all (adaptivity premium > 0).

Sweep extended 200->500 seeds (run_sweep --n 500, 218.6s; regenerated rows 0-199 byte-identical = deterministic). Screen of 450 non-benchmark seeds (gates: headroom>=1000, adapt premium>=600, onset<=12, total stress>=6, calm tail<=6): 91 pass. Shortlist of 8 confirmed with canonical 20-rep oracle refs (k=191..210): all scoreable, headroom20 1238-3178. Rows: 333 PERS 3178, 290 PERS 2803, 481 PERS 1923, 215 PERS 2006, 300 PERS 1666 (quality 7 stressed wks - fills quality coverage hole), 415 ISO 1824, 122 COMP 1347 (18-wk canal event), 345 ISO 1239 (screening 2382 melted to 1239 under 20 reps - single-rep noise).

ISOLATED-profile seeds are structurally low-headroom: only 2 of 91 gate-passing candidates classify ISOLATED (D11 rules). Single-factor stress rarely creates >=1000 headroom, which is why 4 of the 5 bad current seeds are ISOLATED. Supports the de-grouping direction: the ISOLATED group is intrinsically the noisy-skill group.

RLVR reward-design survey (sonnet agent, ~15 sources fetched): terminal-only reward at 26 turns = documented failure regime (RAGEN Echo Trap; TRACE outcome-only GRPO loses 4.5-34 pts to dense turn credit); consensus = terminal anchor + dense signal ONLY if verifiable; our exact per-week oracle makes dense signal verifiable where TRACE needed a frozen-LM proxy. Per-instance reference normalization (our skill score) validated by RRPO/Durian. Proper-scoring-rule belief reward (Brier vs true posterior) = incentive-compatible, trained exactly this way in 2507.16806; MUST stay a separate channel - additive mixing with task reward may destroy strict properness (partially unverified claim, flagged). No prior art found for belief-accuracy as PBRS potential (gap = contribution). Reward-hacking: action-independent tape validated as env hardening (RHB 2605.02964); audit item - RNG stream perturbation via tool-call order/count.

ladder-v2 build complete (user greenlit seed swap + belief field + regret metric): (1) bench_config: EXP=ladder-v2, GROUPS swapped (out 11/24/36/160/164, in 122/300/333/345/415; ISO 10 / PERS 17 / COMP 23 = 50). (2) place_order gains REQUIRED beliefs arg (per-factor prob 0-1, registry-driven vocabulary via tools.belief_factor_ids, strict validation w/ REJECTED retry); new report_final_beliefs tool (post-done only) closes the D2a week-26 hole; prompt updated w/ factor-list substitution for partial worlds. (3) play_agent: BELIEFS trace line, closing turn collects final beliefs, MODEL SNAPSHOT line (D14). (4) runs/parse_beliefs.py: deterministic belief scoring (Brier + detection at p>=0.5), selftest passing - replaces grade_beliefs (no grader LLM) for v2. (5) analysis/tape_truth.py: shared ground-truth stress replay. All 160 tests pass (8 updated for new signature/seed set).

Per-week counterfactual regret shipped (analysis/regret.py): oracle_policy refactored to warm_filters + oracle_play (mid-episode continuation; run_oracle(300,k=50) reproduces 6215 exactly = byte-equivalent). Validation on sonnet seed 1 (reps=2, k=50): replay cost asserts pass all 26 weeks, agent total 8539.0 matches canonical llm_cost, v_start 7227.9 vs canonical oracle mean 6932 (+4%, expected at low reps/k). Regret profile: stockout weeks 23-24 regret ~0 (A2 unavoidable-physics fix working), true failure localized wk13 (+1575 on a $110 week - under-positioning before the wk17 port storm). Per-week MC noise +-~400 at reps=2; production needs reps 5-10 (~17h CPU for 200 episodes).

RNG-hardening audit (reward-survey action item): PASS. Within-week tools (briefing/audit/lock/expedite/inspect) never draw from world rng - no rng/random use in src/agent/service.py; all draws happen once per week inside engine.step()'s kernel loop in fixed registry order. Tool-call order/count cannot perturb the tape.

v2 smoke pilot PASS (qwen/qwen3.6-27b, seed 1, ~35min, <$0.01): 26/26 weeks, ZERO REJECTED (the beliefs schema needed no retries even for a 27B model), 28 BELIEFS lines, final-beliefs turn worked (week 26 stated - D2a hole closed with data), bench.trace_valid True, llm_cost 9330. parse_beliefs.py on the trace: 27/27 weeks stated, mean Brier 0.0799, detection lag 0.5, 1/5 stress episodes never detected. One bug found+fixed: MODEL SNAPSHOT string doubled (langchain streamed-chunk metadata concatenation) - dedupe added in play_agent. Full v2 chain (clean harness -> beliefs validation -> terminal turn -> deterministic scoring) verified end to end.

D16 found by week-by-week pilot-trace audit: engine contract lapse was a silent no-op on LIVE contracts (lapse branch filtered on contract_open, i.e. only dropped expired/dead ones - backwards). Pilot: qwen lapsed spot 4x, no error, dual_source billed all episode ($92). ladder-v1 exposure: 112/200 episodes with lapse attempts (231 calls, all no-ops); grok 37 / deepseek 31 / sonnet 27 / gpt 17 episodes. World physics change is safe pre-ladder-v2: no reference policy calls lapse, so floors/oracle refs stand; ladder-v1 needs a one-sentence disclosure.

Conformance audit (sonnet agent, every prompt/docstring promise vs engine, all repros run live) found 3 BROKEN + 3 AMBIGUOUS promises beyond D16: contract unit_price displayed but never billed (short/long both bill $100.0 while showing 3.88/4.24); break_fee never charged; sign/switch/renew duplicated live contracts (same backwards contract_open filter as D16); backup onboard_weeks=1 display-only (same-week order ships); crisis coupling fires on watch/crash + any supplier (prompt said spot during disruption); empty rationale allowed. FULL RUN GATED ONLY ON: user D13 commit + repeats decision (1x vs 3x).

OpenReview metric-review survey: agent could NOT access any actual review text - openreview.net fully gated behind Cloudflare bot wall (UI, both API versions, Wayback all blocked); agent correctly refused to fabricate quotes. Confirmed forum IDs for manual browser pull: AgentBench zAdUB0aCTQ, WebArena oKn9c6ytLx, GAIA fibxvahvs3, AgentBoard 4S8agvKjle. Verified negative: RetailBench/MerchantBench/Vending-Bench (and likely InventoryBench/AIM-Bench) have NO public peer review - the supply-chain-agent-benchmark subgenre is entirely unreviewed preprints. Secondary-source pattern (authors' own rationale, not reviewers): every confirmed cousin shipped a SECOND-GENERATION metric fixing naive scoring - AgentBench cross-env normalization, tau-bench pass^k (single-run stochasticity), AgentBoard progress rate (vs all-or-nothing success). Our skill score already covers normalization; repeats decision covers stochasticity; KDR/belief channel is the progress-rate analogue.

New-vs-2024 objection classes: metric conflation, proxy-metric validation, estimator derivations, benchmark running-cost reporting, significance policing, LLM-judge skepticism as baseline. Plus manual-pull list (tau2-bench LGmO9VvuP5, TheAgentCompany LZnKNApvhG, WebArena Verified 94tlGxmqkN) and ICLR-2026 in-pipeline index (Gaia2, AgentHard, WAREX).
